sales_data.csv.description: Sales transactions used for revenue, profit, and regional analysis.

columns.order_date: Date of the transaction in ISO format.
columns.customer_segment: Customer segment such as Consumer, Corporate, Home Office.
columns.discount: Discount rate as a decimal between 0 and 1.
columns.profit: Net profit associated with the order.

columns.target_revenue: Monthly target revenue in the same currency as actual revenue.
